name: Origami Solutions
source:
Embark on a gripping tale of loyalty, betrayal, and family ties as you guide Adam through a world of power struggles and moral complexities. Uncover dark secrets, navigate intricate relationships, and witness the consequences of every choice, shaping not only Adam's destiny but the fate of those entangled in the web of secrecy.

[From [url=https://roomahgaming.itch.io/origami-solutions]itch.io[/url]]

Submission to Improve My Game Jam 30, "Finish Your Game" Jam 2023, GW Monthly Game Jam Challenge #1 (November 2023), Indiepocalypse Issue #49 (Paying Anthology) and to Mini Jam 146: Windows
translation:
当你引导亚当穿越一个充满权力斗争和道德复杂性的世界时，踏上一个关于忠诚、背叛和家庭关系的扣人心弦的故事。揭开黑暗的秘密，处理错综复杂的关系，见证每一个选择的后果，不仅塑造亚当的命运，也塑造那些卷入秘密之网的人的命运。

[来自[url=https://roomahgaming.itch.io/origami-solutions]itch.io[/url]]

提交改进我的游戏Jam 30、“完成你的游戏”Jam 2023、GW每月Game Jam挑战 #1（2023年11月）、Indiepocalypse问题 #49（付费选集）和Mini Jam 146：Windows
